label: GO after an a1 rare-rewarded trial, at the very end of the episode (low value)
explanation: Fires only at GO steps, only after a rewarded previous trial (in_rew=0 at GO, prev_reward=1 in 100% of mass), almost only when the previous choice was a1 (97.5% of mass) and that trial had a rare transition (95% of mass), and only in the last trials of the episode (99.7% of mass in ep_trial 90-99), where the model value head is low (all activations have value < 5.22). So it is the a1 rare-rewarded (model-based switch) case, gated by an end-of-episode / low-value signal. The agent usually switches to a2 here (model_act=2 carries 91% of mass). The predicate uses only observed history plus the model own value output, so no future variables. Using ep_trial >= 95 in place of value < 4 gives dev F1 0.63 and mass recall 0.88; value < 4 gives dev F1 0.70 and mass recall 0.95. The largest activations come at the episode last GO steps (rel +1, reward unknown), and smaller ones come a few trials earlier, so magnitude grows toward episode end and as value falls. It does not fire at D1 or D2, after unrewarded trials, after a2 choices, or after common-rewarded a1 trials. Some false positives are a1 rare-rewarded GO steps with low value where it stays silent, often when earlier context trials were a2.
